page.content:
Underworld the sun-boat and the dead must cross by night.

How Duat connects

  • Character: Osiris — Osiris judges and rules in the Duat.
  • Event: Weighing of the heart — The heart is weighed in Osiris' hall in the Duat.
  • Creator: Ra — Ra travels the Duat each night to be reborn at dawn.
  • Work: Book of the Dead — The Book of the Dead maps spells for passing the Duat.

What is Duat?

The Duat is the nocturnal otherworld: gates, demons, the judgment hall of Osiris, and the path Ra takes from dusk to dawn. Funerary books map it as a geography, not a metaphor only.

Key threads lead to Osiris, Weighing of the heart, Ra and Book of the Dead.
